name: Money Manager
tagline: Personal finance tracking, built native for Android.
description: A personal finance app with per-category budgets, CSV import/export, multi-wallet asset/liability tracking, and month-over-month stats built on a fully reactive Compose + Room stack.

name: Kinematic Hand Tracking
tagline: A Fruit Ninja-style game controlled entirely by your hands.
description: A real-time computer vision game using webcam hand tracking to slice falling objects, dual-hand blade trails, combo multipliers, particle effects, and delta-time physics running at a steady frame rate.
